I wanted to initiate a discussion for just one of the vital elements of a subverse: its sidebar.

Anything from basic rules, to information about the subverse, to the decision to include related subverses, etc. What is important to keep in mind? What is too much / too little to include? Discuss.
At /v/dice I put the rule, the resource, and some links to shopping and cool shit.

Hard to say what is important in a general sense. I think that would change greatly depending on what type of sub it is.

I think an entertainment type of sub should take a minimalist approach to the side bar. Keep it simple, because nobody is going to read more than a small amount.

But if it is focused on serious discussion, then the opposite can be true. Then additional information and links to other resources, become vital.

One thing that should probably be on all side bars though is a concise description of topic or purpose for the sub.

I think whatever you put in the sidebar, it should be clear and to the point.

cdb, I noticed you have the description of your sub in italics. I would suggest using bold or plain.

Keep it simple, and, if you add things, do it over time. Organically.

Just as example, look how clean it is at v/technology
